title: Malaysian-Style Light Almond Biriyani
description: A flavorful vegetarian dish made with almond and light flavors, inspired by malaysian cuisine. Perfect for a light meal or dinner.
instructions: 1. Rinse the basmati rice in a fine mesh strainer and drain.
2. In a medium saucepan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
3. Add the curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
4. Add the almond milk and bring to a simmer.
5. Add the basmati rice and stir to coat with the curry mixture.
6. Cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
7. Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the kissed cashews.
9. Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
